tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃཿ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan rgyud zab mo'i skor las: bde chen zhing sgrub kyi byang chog thar lam dkar po bzhugs so:

hatar: bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'di'i sgo nas byang bu ni: dang po mdun du tshe 'das kyi: ro'am rus dum skra chun nam: gzugs brnyan ming rus bris pa'am: bsdu na nṛ yig tsam gyis chog: theb rtse gcig tu lcog rdog ni: gsum mam yan na gcig kyang rung : chang bu ting lo gcig gam gsum: til nag gam ni yungs gzhi dang : bye ma 'dod yon bcas pa bshams: zhing sgrub cho ga sngon song tshe: bum nang lha tshogs gsal ba la: dmigs pa gtad la mang du bsnyen: dmigs rten bran la 'di skad do: oṃ ka ti ma nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs: mdun du tshe las 'das pa ni: che ge gson po'i gzugs ltar gyur: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: yi dam lha yi bden pa yis: che ge'i rnam par shes pa de: steng 'og bar gsum gar gnas pa'i: gnas nas gzugs dang ming rus 'dir: khug cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ de ni lan gsum brjod pa'o: de nas lcog rdog chang bu ni: ting lo bshams la bran byas te: bh+rūṃ las rin chen snod nang du: gtor ma so so'i yid mthun pa'i: longs spyod dpag tu med par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid la: gson po'i bdud dang shi ba'i gshed: khyed rnams gtor ma 'di khyer la: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid la: thar pa'i bgegs ni khyod ma byed: gal te mi nyan byas gyur na: nga nyid lha yi nga rgyal bskyed: khyod kyi mgo bo dum bur 'gems: de bas ma 'dug phyir dengs shig: lcog rdog rten la g.yas bskor zhing : na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: zhes brjod lcog rdog sder du blug: de 'dra lan gsum byas pa zhi spyod yin: de nas theb kyu'am ting lo dang : changs bu bran la bzung byas te: hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa 'di la ni: bar du gcod dang 'khri ba dang : thos dang reg dang rtog pa yi: gdon bgegs gson bdud gshin lcags kyis:

changs bu ting lo 'di bzhes la: ma gnas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: gal te 'gro bar mi byed na: bdag ni khro rgyal dbang chen te: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: rdo rje dmyal bar shi ka re: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: changs bu ting lo g.yon du bskor zhing : oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐: sogs lan gsum brjod cing sder du phul: zhi drag phyed mar spyod pa'o: de nas drag por sbyong ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni lha yi ting 'dzin gyi: 'od kyis phyogs bcu thams cad gang : phyogs rnams thams cad bde chen zhing : gang ba de las 'od 'phros pas: tshe 'das 'di la gnod byed pa'i: srog gcod mdangs 'phrog byed pa rnams: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ: zhes sogs gsum brjod nas lcags kyis brabs: de nas mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang la: 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur: bar mtshams rdo rje'i rwa bar gyur: me dpung chen pos mtshams gcod nas: gshed kyis tshugs pa med par gyur: oṃ badz+ra na mi rak+ṣa hūm̐: mdun du me chu til gsum bshams: tshe 'das snying gar pam̐ nag po: de la sdig sgrib thams cad thim: sdig pa rwa tsa'i gzugs gyur pa: rkang mthil yaṃ las rlung g.yos pas: lte ba'i raṃ las gtum mo 'bar: sna bug g.yas nas sdig pa de: mdun gyi til la thim par gyur: me ni zhi ba'i thab khung dbus: za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing : rdor dril 'dzin cing khro chas rdzogs: zhal du sdig pa phul bas bsregs: lag pa g.yas g.yon til blangs la: lan dgu bskor zhing me chur dor: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi: sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru ye swā hā: rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbyings su gshegs: badz+ra mu: sa'am bye ma sngags la 'debs: oṃ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi kha bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta na ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhrī swā hā: tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas lha khrus gsol ba ni: bum pa lag tu thog byas te: mchod gzhi'i dngos la me long bstan: hūm̐: bdag gis dri ldan dri chab kyis: 'od dpag sku la khrus gsol lo: lha la dri ma mi mnga' yang : sdig sgrib dag pa'i rten 'brel bgyi: 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan: thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med: byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te: ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: de nas ras kyi phyi tshul dang : na bza' gsol ba'i tshul bya zhing : hūm̐: ras dkar 'jam dri ldan pa yis: 'od dpag sku nyid phyi bar bgyi: sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang : sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐: na bza' mdzes ldan ngur smrig 'di: rgyal ba'i sku la gsol bar bgyi: sku la bsil ba mi mnga' yang : bkrag mdangs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐: khrus chu bum pa gzhan du blugs: med na bum pa de gas rung : tshe 'das la ni me long bstan: hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang : 'od dpag med pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs: khyod kyi sgrib pa sbyang bar gyur: dug gsum gtan nas dag gyur cig: 'di ni pha rol phyin drug chu: dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing : phar phyin drug la legs 'god chu: khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o: chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas: bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni: gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas: dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing : rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa: khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga': dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi: yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa: sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du: dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o:

oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shud+dhe shud+dhe bi shud+dhe swā hā: tshig mtshams kun tu sngags de nyid: brjod cing me long gzugs brnyan bkru: de nas dug sbyong dug bcom ni: bye ma thogs la 'di skad brjod: hūṃ: tshe 'das khyod kyi dug gsum dang : dug lnga dug brgyad sgrib pa rnams: 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs kyis: byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga': dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ tshe 'das kyi dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod bye ma gtab par bya: theb rtse gcig tu sa chu me : bum pa'i ku sha dang bcas bzung : 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te: 'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis: tshe 'das dug gi dug med shog: rten la bskor zhing rlung g.yab ste: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ tshe 'das kyi 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i dug thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod khrus sder nang du blugs: sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang : lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis: khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa: don de de ring 'grub gyur cig: rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog: rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog: khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog: phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog: nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs: nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing : nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shog: khyod la sdig pa ma gyur cig: me tog nas ni gtor bya zhing : tshe 'das mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig: chos bshad gdams ngag ston pa ni: hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa che ge khyod: rigs drug gnas su 'khyams srid pas: rigs drug mgon po thub chen drug:

gsol ba thob dang grol bar 'gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: nye du yod na phyag 'tshal bcug: tshe 'das nyid kyis 'tshal bar dmigs: e ma ho: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob dang ni: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med rnams la: tshe 'das gus pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo: bde ba can gyi zhing du lam sna drongs: nyon drug gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: phyin drug chos ston nyon drug rnam par dag: rigs drug thub pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can: rgyal ba thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro ba rigs drug skye sgo gcad du gsol: rjes zlos bya zhing phyag ni ci mang 'tshal: tshe 'das nyid kyis zer bar bsgom bya zhing : kyai ma 'od dpag med mgon gson: bdag 'dra'i tshe 'das sdig can 'di: 'khor ba'i skyon gyis non lags pas: bdag ni khyed la skyabs su mchi: khyed kyi thugs rjes bzung nas kyang : bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol: rjes zlos tshul du lan gsum brjod: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gdams pa ni: tshe 'das de yis len par dmigs: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: rjes zlos byas dmigs lan gsum brjod: me tog chu skyes pad+ma'i steng : de nang tshe 'das sems dpa' dkar: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: bde ba can nas 'od dpag gis: sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan tshogs: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon: tshe 'das nyid la sib sib thim: hūm̐: bde chen zhing gi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan 'di la dbang mchog bskur: log 'dren thar pa'i bar chad bsal du gsol: dril bu 'khrol zhing sngags 'di gsum mam bdun brjod: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ

badz+ra a we sha ya a a: rdo rje mgo la bzhag tshul gyis: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bum pa lag tu thogs la: hūm̐: slob ma tshe las 'das pa nyon: bum pa 'di ni phyi ltar na: rin chen bum pa yin mod kyang : nang ni rin chen gzhal yas khang : de yi nang na 'od dpag med: bde ba can gyi lha tshogs bzhugs: de las byin rlabs char ltar babs: khyod kyi lus la thim nas kyang : dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣeñca hrī: 'di yi mtshams su zas bsngo 'don: ༁ྃ: na tha dang : na mo dhe wa pañca ye: zas gtad ni: tsaka li'i rgyab yig tu byas nas: 'di skad du ni brjod par bya: yid mthun snod kyi nang du ni: sha thud mar chang ja rnams ni: zag med bde ba skyed byed pa'i: ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur: oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: bar do'i sems can dri yis tshim: zas sna'i gsur byas bran nas kyang : 'di skad du ni brjod par bya: kyai ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: zas skom thabs kyi chags yod dang : skye ba sngon gyi bu lon dang : yi dwags gnas su skye shom na: bdag gi 'di nyid bsngos pa 'di: rtsa gsum lha yi bden pa yis: bsngos bzhin khyod kyis thob par shog: sarba ta thā ga ta hūm̐: tsaka li rgyab yig byas nas ni: bkra shis rtags brgyad lag tu thogs: de nas 'di ltar brjod par bya: 'o tshe 'das che ge khyod nyon dang : bdag gis bkra shis rtags brgyad 'di: byin pa bzhin du thob nas kyang : bkra shis bde legs 'grub par shog: aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ hūm̐: tsaka li rgyab yig byas nas ni: rgyal srid sna bdun thogs byas nas: 'di skad du ni brjod par bya: e ma rigs kyi bu khyod nyon: bdag gis rin chen sna bdun 'di: bsngos pa bzhin du thob nas kyang : 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lta bur shog: rat+na dra bya maṅga laṃ hūm̐: tsaka li rgyab yig byas nas ni: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i sku thogs la:

'di skad du ni brjod par bya: 'o khyod ni dpal bo yab yum ltar: dga' ba rnam bzhi ngos bzung nas: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gnas shog: oṃ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa maṅga laṃ hūm̐: kye ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: longs spyod tshogs 'di rab tu long : zas kyi tha ma 'di yin pas: skye ba gtan gyi longs spyod zas: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la spyod: sbyin pa'i pha rol yongs rdzogs pa'i: zas gtad 'di ni dga' bas longs: gson yang gshin la mi phreng ngo : gshin yang gson la ma chags par: bde chen dag pa'i zhing du gshegs: oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā: laṃ bha ta: bha du ya ya: a li u li: ta li ta li ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas mar me mdun du bzhag: me sbar ba yi dmigs pa ni: kong bu pad+ma zla ba'i steng : mar khu sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: sdong bu hrīḥyig dmar po la: ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: tshe 'das dug lnga'i sdig sgrib dang : ma dag phung po lnga bsregs nas: dag pa 'od dpag med pa'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par gyur: hūm̐: me 'di'i rtsa ba sngo ba de: rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes me: de steng me mdog dmar ba de: snang ba mtha' yas ye shes me: me 'di'i rked pa ser ba de: rin chen 'byung ldan ye shes me: de steng me mdog dkar ba de: rnam par snang mdzad ye shes me: me yi rtse mo nag pa de: don yod grub pa'i ye shes me: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me yin no: ye shes lnga yi me dpung gis: khyod kyi phung po lnga bsregs pas: dug lnga gtan nas dag nas kyang : ye shes sku lnga thob par shog: oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ 'phral der ming yig mi bzhu na: mar me la ni bstan tsam bya: rig pa tshe 'das kho la gtad: bzhu na bla ma rgyang 'bod dang : gzugs med sgra med dri med ro med reg bya med chos med do: zhes dang gzungs sngags 'don bzhin du: rig pa tshe 'das kho la gtad: nyams len lta ba'i ngang nas bzhu:

de nas lam bstan bya ba ni: tshe 'das 'od dpag med pa'i sku: nub kyi phyogs su zhal gzigs nas: mdun gyi bar snang khams su ni: zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par dmigs: hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa khyod nyid ni: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing : phan yon che ba'i zhing yod pas: dag pa'i gnas gcig de yin no: lho nub za byed srin po'i yul: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs: skye yang sla ste phan yon chung : de min sangs rgyas zhing gzhan rnams: rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i zhing khams yin: skye bar dka' bas de skyur la: bde ba can du 'gro bar gyis: rang gi sna bug nas rlung shugs drag po gcig 'phros nas: bar snang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la phog pas: zla ba'i steng du tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa 'od dpag med kyi skur gsal ba de: mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du bde ba can du gshegs par gyur: phaṭa: gal te gson shog yin na ni: tshe 'das zhes par tshe ldan sbyar: zas sngo lam bstan gnyis po skyur: zla ba'i steng du me dpung nang : sbyin bdag 'od dpag med pa'i sku: gnas gsum 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing : lte ba gsang ba gtsug tor du: ho ser haṃ ljang k+ṣa dud kha: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun: mthing dkar ser dang dmar po yi: rnam par spyan drangs lus la thim: rdo rje'i go khrab gyon par gyur: oṃ hrīḥmaṃ na ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: bsod nams ri bo bzhin du

sogs: lo brgya thub cing sogs: de nas bsngo ba rgyas pa'am: yang na cho ga nyid kyi mjug: e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas zhes sogs nas: bo dha nā ye swā hā: 'di bar brjod: bdag ni tshe 'phos zhes pa'i mal: gang yin de yi ming bcug go: byang thal tshwa tshwa 'grub na legs: ma 'grub gzhung chu'i nang du blugs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ye kha thaṃ: thashat+yat+yathrashogu+odhe: ces pa 'di nyid spru la sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis pa me sprel gyi lo khrum stod zla ba'i yar tshes dgu'i nyin: dpal rno bkra'i gzhung nas gsungs pa dang mthun pa'i thugs rje chen po sngo skya zhal gsum phyag drug pa gcig gis dngos su bka' stsal to: zhes gnam chos byang chog gzhung dang : de yis bsngos bzhin thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sham thadha/ blad+ya/ da: zhes sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis pa: me sprel khrum stod zla ba'i tshes brgyad nub: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung nyin nas gsungs pa ltar zhal gzigs te: thugs rje chen po dang 'od dpag med gnyis mgrin gcig tu 'di ltar bka' stsal to: zhes pa gnam chos zas gtad dang : ma yig bu yig gnyis gab sprad: gnam chos rang gzhung dang gzhan nas kha bskang 'os cung zad kyis kha bskangs te: rtogs ldan karma sogs gsar bu 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir: bya lo 'brug zla'i nyer bzhi'i nyin: dge slong brtson 'grus kyis yi ge ba byas te: gter blon rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa la: nyes 'gal mchis na chos bdag srung ma'i tshogs la bshags shing : dge bas 'di dang 'brel tshad nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye bar gyur cig: maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000120
